set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/mvpa. Acceptance: add SampleAxis and aligned Response/FoldPlan contexts so fold-required analyses cannot run without folds; fix RSA label-aware scoring so PartialPearson receives labeled RDMs; distinguish FeatureSetPlan Region vs Searchlight and require valid searchlight centers; add CrossDomainDataset/PairedFeatureSet for cross-decoding; type shrinkage/ridge scalars; add LabeledRdm/RsaItemId and typed RoiAnalysis payload/error shapes. Verification: mvpaJVM/test and mvpaJS/test, including RSA PartialPearson regression.
set.title: Type MVPA sample axes, folds, RDM labels, feature-set kinds, and payloads
